facts.fact: L'Echo d'Algerie reports the Mediator of the Republic officially launched on 2023-10-28 an electronic portal for grievance registers and correspondence with ministries, to feed a national complaints database; the Algiers delegation had received 1,877 requests by 30 September 2023, not stated to be through the portal.
